card.name: Punctuation inside textbook citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and publisher words in medical textbook references, such as the period after 'ed' or the colon after 'Philadelphia, Pa', especially in Rosen's Emergency Medicine and Saunders/Mosby entries. Also fires partway through some drug-class names.

modes.label: Textbook citation
modes.description: Periods, colons or publisher names inside a book reference after edition and city details.
modes.example: Marx J, et al. Rosen's Emergency Medicine. 7th ed<<.>> St. Louis, MO: Mosby

modes.label: Inside drug-class names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug-class words like prothrombin, endothelin and angiotensin.
modes.example: The use of prothrom<<bin>> complex concentrates (PCC), or other
